headline: 950 children dead: Measles death toll stands at 950 in Bangladesh
summary: Seven more children died within 24 hours as the measles outbreak continues to claim lives.
details: The measles death toll in Bangladesh has reached 950 children. This alarming increase is driven by a recent surge in cases across the country.
In the last 24 hours alone, seven more children have lost their lives to the disease.
Measles is a highly contagious viral infection that can lead to severe complications, especially in unvaccinated children.
Health authorities are working to intensify vaccination campaigns to curb the spread of the virus and prevent further fatalities.

headline_marked: Trump administration [[pauses US visa appointments worldwide]]
headline: Trump administration pauses US visa appointments worldwide
summary: The US State Department has suspended visa services globally to conduct training for consular officers as part of a broader immigration crackdown.
details: The Trump administration has issued a global pause on visa appointments for applicants worldwide. This move comes amid an ongoing immigration crackdown during the Republican leader's second term in the White House.

A US State Department spokesperson stated that the pause is to accommodate a global training initiative at all US embassies and consulates. The training aims to help officers screen out applicants likely to become dependent on US public benefits.

The administration is pursuing an aggressive deportation drive and immigration crackdown, which includes the revocation of visas and green cards. Some applications have been rejected based on political opinions or protests against the assault on Gaza.
Immigrant visa applicants with scheduled interviews have already received emails stating their appointments are being rescheduled. They are told they will receive notice of new dates in the future.
The crackdown has faced legal challenges, with a US judge recently striking down a policy that suspended immigrant visas for applicants from 75 countries, ruling it exceeded statutory authority.

Human rights groups have condemned these measures as discriminatory and in violation of free speech and due process. They warn that the environment has become unsafe, particularly for ethnic minorities facing racial profiling.
